creatures.name: Giant Rat
creatures.description: A dog-sized sewer scavenger that swarms anything that looks like dinner.
creatures.skills: Disadvantage on Charm checks. Advantage on Senses (smell).
creatures.tactics: Comes in packs. Use 1 rat per player for an easy fight.

creatures.name: Goblin
creatures.description: A sneaky, cackling raider with a rusty knife and a talent for ambush.
creatures.skills: Advantage on Charm checks to hide.
creatures.tactics: Hides first, then jumps the weakest looking player. Flees at half health.

creatures.name: Skeleton
creatures.description: Animated bones with a notched sword and no will of its own.
creatures.skills: Disadvantage on Wits and Charm checks.
creatures.tactics: Marches straight at the nearest player. Never retreats.

creatures.name: Orc Warrior
creatures.description: A scarred brute in mismatched armor who loves a straight fight.
creatures.skills: Advantage on Physique (threats). Disadvantage on Wits.
creatures.tactics: Charges the biggest threat. Gets in the way of its friends.

creatures.name: Giant Spider
creatures.description: A wall-crawling ambusher that wraps its prey in silk and bites from above.
creatures.skills: Advantage on Charm checks to hide and Physique checks to climb.

powers.name: Venom Bite
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is poisoned (disadvantage) until it rests.

creatures.tactics: Drops from the ceiling. Saves its venom for a player in light armor.

creatures.name: Ogre
creatures.description: A lumbering giant with a club made from a small tree.
creatures.skills: Advantage on Physique (athletics, fists). Disadvantage on Wits and Senses.
creatures.tactics: Swings at whoever is closest. Easy to trick, hard to survive.

creatures.name: Restless Ghost
creatures.description: A pale shape drifting through the walls of the house it died in.
creatures.skills: Advantage on Charm checks to hide and frighten. Disadvantage on Physique checks.

powers.name: Chilling Wail
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. Passes through walls to reach its target.

creatures.tactics: Appears, wails, vanishes into a wall. Weapons without magic or silver roll with disadvantage.

creatures.name: Cave Troll
creatures.description: A hulking, warty monster whose wounds close faster than they open.
creatures.skills: Advantage on Physique. Disadvantage on Charm and Wits.

powers.name: Regenerate
powers.text: Heals itself for 2d6. Fire or acid in the same turn stops it.

creatures.tactics: Fights until hurt, regenerates, fights again. Best solved with fire.

creatures.name: Dragon
creatures.description: An ancient scaled tyrant sitting on a mountain of coin.
creatures.skills: Advantage on all Charm checks. Advantage on Senses.

powers.name: Fire Breath
powers.text: Area of effect 1d6 to 1 pencil radius, 6s explode, ignores defense. Burns terrain too.

powers.name: Crushing Dive
powers.text: Direct-target 2d6 damage, ignores defense. The target is knocked prone.

creatures.tactics: Opens with Fire Breath on a group, then picks off stragglers from the air. Offers a deal if losing.
